findings: Proof of Prop. 7, first paragraph (l.466–468), statement unaffected: « il suffit, pour obtenir E'', d'ajouter à E' un nombre fini de lignes brisées reliant les composantes connexes de E' » presupposes that two points of a connected V are joined by a broken line. The paper does not prove this before Prop. 7. The proof of Prop. 5 (l.432–434) asserts the same fact, while Prop. 4 covers only a compact connected E. The formalization joins the pieces topologically instead: the points lying with a fixed x₀ in some compact connected set form a clopen set (exists_isCompact_isPreconnected_superset). This needs no broken line and covers n = 0, where no broken line of majorised segments exists.

Proof of Prop. 7, l.477–479, statement unaffected: « Il résulte de la proposition 6 que gN ∈ P » applies Prop. 6 to the image gL, a broken line from gN⁰ = M⁰ to gN, not to L. Two steps are left implicit. (a) A projective automorphism carries a segment majorised by k to a segment majorised by k (2°; IsMajoreSeg.smul, and IsLigneBrisee.smul here). (b) p ≤ n(E, k) and K > 1 give 1/K^{n(E,k)} ≤ 1/K^p, the hypothesis Prop. 6 needs.

Prop. 7 uses only « B ∈ P » from Prop. 6 (l.479). So the Prop. 6 finding (false as printed for a pocket of cote z ≡ 0, T-bz-c2-lignes) does not reach Prop. 7. The corrected IsPocheProj.ligne_brisee_poche gives B ∈ P for every pocket.

Dimension 0 (the planner's [r], checked): the printed proof does not run for n = 0, because n(E, k) is undefined and Prop. 4 fails (OQ-45). The statement still holds: a connected V charted on S(0) has at most one point, and the pocket is nonempty. Prop. 7 and its corollary hold as printed in every dimension (compactDansPochePrinted, deuxPointsDansPochePrinted), so these rows do not depend on OQ-45.

kb_proposals: Compact connected sets in a manifold (Chapter2/Compact.lean). Every point of a space charted on a locally compact, locally connected T2 model has a compact preconnected neighbourhood, with no T2 on the manifold (exists_isCompact_isPreconnected_mem_nhds_of_chartedSpace). In a preconnected space with such neighbourhoods every compact set lies in a compact preconnected set (exists_isCompact_isPreconnected_superset, by a clopen argument with no paths or broken lines). For S(n), first haveI := locPathConnectedSpace_S n, which gives LocallyConnectedSpace.
To get a point of a pocket with cote below a positive bound ε, use hP.isGLB.exists_between (show 0 < ε) and destructure the image membership (M⁰ in Prop. 7).
ligne_brisee needs (n := n) when E's type does not fix n; otherwise « typeclass instance problem is stuck NeZero ?m ».

Broken lines are invariant under projective automorphisms: IsLigneBrisee.smul (Compact.lean), by induction with smul_set_union. It belongs next to IsMajoreSeg.smul and is a candidate to move into Lignes at graduation.
